quarterly_data.signal: AEP's second-quarter 2026 earnings release reports revenue of $5,445 million for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026 versus $5,087 million a year earlier, and $11,465 million year-to-date versus $10,550 million. Its preliminary regulated connected-load sales data for the three months ended June 30 show commercial retail sales up 14.9% at the Vertically Integrated Utilities and up 17.4% at the Transmission & Distribution Utilities, where industrial retail sales rose 15.0%.
